title: Clean Code - Uncle Bob / Lesson 1
summary: The first lesson of Uncle Bob (Robert C. Martin)'s "Coding Better World Together" series. It makes the case for clean code and for treating software craftsmanship as an ethical and professional responsibility. It runs about 109 minutes.
why: HN commenters call it better than the Clean Code book, a must-watch for engineers that changes how they read and write code.

quote.text: Clean Code is a great book, but the presentation is so much better
